facts.text: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.
facts.why: Murtaugh's 50th is a surprise party at home, and the car scene says the birthday was yesterday. Riggs meets the family at a separate dinner where Roger introduces his new partner and the roast comes out.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Riggs meets the family over a roast dinner.

facts.why: The birthday is a separate surprise party at home, and Riggs is not at it. His first dinner with the family is the roast, and he returns on Christmas Day.
Riggs never stays in the Murtaugh guest room. The film opens with him waking up in his trailer, which Wikipedia confirms in the production notes.
facts.fix: Riggs wakes up in his trailer

vibe.verdict: Right family kitchen and Christmas feel, but it never reaches for the film's best-known moments.
